verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Amplitude Experiment offers a management API to create and control flags programmatically. Nothing in the pack covers roles, per-flag permissions, or scoped API tokens that restrict who can change which flags. A programmatic API is a related feature, not access control, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
